name: daily-planner
description: Slash command to create daily schedule in Grok

examples.input: /daily-planner date: 'Today' tasks: 'Write report, Review code' events: 'Team standup 10 AM' goals: 'Finish report'
examples.output:
Daily Schedule:
8-10 AM: Write report (deep work)
10-10:15 AM: Team standup
10:15-12 PM: Continue report
12-1 PM: Lunch
1-2 PM: Review code
2-3 PM: Finish report

usage: Use /daily-planner in Grok chat to create daily schedules
